sections.summary: Frames web development as a high-impact, lucrative field and announces the video will cover 101 concepts needed to build full-stack web apps.

Rapid-fire walkthrough of foundational web development concepts spanning the internet and protocols, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and the DOM, frameworks, Node.js and npm, HTTP and APIs, SEO, build tooling, and hosting/deployment options.
Congratulates viewers on completing 'web development 101', thanks them for watching, and signs off until the next video.
